mode_note: twin: the SV08 twin in the engine, full physics (servo-driven axes, PrintedPart). ideal: printing/ideal_print.py, no engine: the same Klipper plan, hotend and laying rule with the nozzle exactly where the steppers would put it, so the axis dynamics (following error, overshoot, jitter) are left out and a part reads about 0.02-0.03 mm smaller a side than on the twin (printing/README.md, "Ideal print (no engine)").

before_bead_fix.note: The dumps PrintedPart laid before the 2026-11-04 bead fix are kept in .tmp/spark_print/before_bead_fix/. A plate's after column is empty until it has been printed again in that mode.
